name: comp-331
title: Edit Profile Dialog
description: A dialog for editing a profile: a wide cover photo and round avatar sit above first and last name, username, website and bio fields. Save or Cancel closes it and the bio shows how many characters remain.
use: Collecting a user's photo, name, website and bio in one short form without leaving the current page.
avoid: The cover and avatar load from bundled demo image paths, so real deployments must point them at their own files.
a11y: Labels, aria-labels and a polite live character counter are present, and focus rings are visible; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded dialog floats over a near-black page. Under the title and close cross is a wide landscape cover photo with a circular avatar overlapping its lower edge. Below are paired name fields, a username field with a green tick, a website field prefixed https://, a bio textarea, and two footer buttons.
behaves: A trigger button opens the dialog over the page. Typing in the fields updates the bio's remaining-character counter, and selecting text inside a field highlights it. Cancel or Save changes closes the dialog.
customise: Copy, default names and the two demo image paths are written inside the file and need editing; width and field layout are set with utility classes.
weight: light: A small dialog of form fields and images; nothing animates except the opening transition.
demo: Edit profile trigger, sample user Margaret Villard, username margaret-villard-69, site www.margaret.com and a short bio.
issues: Cover and avatar default to demo image URLs that can break outside the origin setup.
Small helper and footer text is low contrast on the dark surface.
polishWhy: Tidy standard dialog; demo image defaults and faint small text keep it ordinary.
